name: public-private-overlay
description: The Public Plugin, Private Overlay standard for agent plugins, aligned with Anthropic's plugin and skill guidance: one public generic plugin, the user's own content in a consistent overlay folder outside ~/.claude, caches in CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA, secrets in sensitive userConfig. audit-plugins audits a publisher's marketplaces and plugins against it (leaks of personal particulars or secrets, storage rules, overlay conformance, skill limits, version drift) and brings them into line in approved batches. check-guidance re-reads the Anthropic docs the standard quotes and proposes updates when they change.
